svg.text: M1 schema · 7 tables · drawn by Ahmed, 11 Oct 2026 · P1/P3/P4 = phase that builds the table · "?" = nullable
Enums: ScaffoldLevel = FULL | HALF | NONE. QuestionStatus = DRAFT | VERIFIED (only VERIFIED questions are ever served).

ATTEMPT.scaffold_level snapshots the level the question was shown at. ATTEMPT is the source of truth; PROGRESS counters are a cache (ADR-003). password_hash: never store a raw password. source_administration is stored as YYYY-MM (2026-01) so it sorts by date; empty source columns mean the question is not from a past exam.
